## Project Ownership

This project is being developed under the supervision of **Soham Kinhikar**.

Until the agreed project scope is completed and delivery is accepted, all rights to the code in this repository are owned by **Pursue Networking** under **Soham Kinhikar**.

The repository contains the private implementation of the ANDI system, including internal orchestration logic, relationship intelligence models, ingestion pipelines, and infrastructure code.

This repository is intended strictly for internal development and approved collaborators only.

## Repository Governance

This repository follows milestone-based development.

Implementation is divided into structured milestones for controlled execution, validation, and delivery.

Milestone documents are maintained under: `/docs/milestones/`

---

## Milestone Documentation

| Milestone   | Title                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Milestone 0 | Customer Discovery & Scope Alignment |
| Milestone 1 | Data Ingestion, Cleaning & Storage   |
| Milestone 2 | Scoring & Noise Model                |
| Milestone 3 | Private Integration Layer            |
| Milestone 4 | Model Iteration & Tuning             |
| Milestone 5 | Final Product & Beta Readiness       |

Total scoped project value: **$21,500**, allocated across the six milestones.

Detailed documentation is maintained in the milestone files.
